deskripsi: Latihan verbal dan bacaan bahasa Inggris: synonym, antonym, verbal analogy, word classification, logical reasoning, different word, vocabulary, narrative text, surat, dan cloze text.

soal.penjelasan: Swift (cepat) bersinonim dengan quick.

soal.soal: Furious = .........
soal.penjelasan: Furious (sangat marah) bersinonim dengan angry.
Brief (singkat) bersinonim dengan short.
Purchase (membeli) bersinonim dengan buy.
Omit (menghilangkan) bersinonim dengan delete.
Lawan kata permit (mengizinkan) adalah forbid (melarang).
Lawan kata selfish (egois) adalah generous (dermawan).
Lawan kata fortune (keberuntungan) adalah bad luck (kesialan).
Lawan kata lovely (menyenangkan) adalah terrible (mengerikan).
Lawan kata natural (alami) adalah artificial (buatan).

soal.soal: Bird is to wing as fish is to ..........
soal.penjelasan: Burung bergerak dengan sayap; ikan bergerak dengan sirip (fin).

soal.soal: Circle is to sphere as square is to .......
soal.penjelasan: Lingkaran (2D) menjadi bola (3D); persegi (2D) menjadi kubus (3D).

soal.soal: Oxygen is to respiration as glucose is to ..........
soal.penjelasan: Oksigen digunakan dalam respirasi; glukosa adalah sumber energi. Soal ini dapat ditafsirkan lain (C).

soal.soal: Jungle is to monkey as desert is to ......
soal.penjelasan: Monyet hidup di hutan; unta hidup di gurun.

soal.soal: Hunt is to lion as ............ is to cow.
soal.penjelasan: Singa berburu (hunt); sapi merumput (graze).

soal.soal:
The sun sets beautifully over the calm ocean.
The underlined word "beautifully" is ....
soal.penjelasan: Beautifully menerangkan kata kerja 'sets', jadi adverb.

soal.soal:
I did not do that on purpose.
The underlined word "on" is ....
soal.penjelasan: 'On' adalah preposisi pada frasa 'on purpose'.

soal.soal:
She is nice enough if you keep your distance.
The underlined word "distance" is ....
soal.penjelasan: Distance (jarak) adalah kata benda, objek dari 'keep your'.

soal.soal: Go and ............ your piano-playing now.
soal.penjelasan: Kalimat perintah setelah 'Go and' memakai kata kerja bentuk dasar: practice.

soal.soal:
As he was walking across the field, Rama spotted a small puppy tied to a post.
The underlined word "As" is a ....
soal.penjelasan: 'As' menghubungkan dua klausa (waktu), jadi conjunction.

soal.soal: All mammals have lungs. A whale is a mammal, therefore ....

pilihan.A: A whale does not have lungs

soal.penjelasan: Paus adalah mamalia, dan semua mamalia punya paru-paru.

soal.soal: All fruits have seeds. A tomato is a fruit, therefore .......

pilihan.A: A tomato does not have seeds.
pilihan.B: A tomato is not a fruit.

soal.penjelasan: Tomat adalah buah, dan semua buah punya biji.

soal.soal: All suspects who had access to the safe are employees. Jhon is not an employee. Therefore .......

pilihan.A: Jhon had access to the safe.
pilihan.C: Jhon did not have access to the safe
pilihan.D: Jhon is an employee but didn't have access to the safe

soal.penjelasan: Yang punya akses semuanya karyawan; Jhon bukan karyawan, jadi ia tidak punya akses.

soal.soal: No reptiles have fur. A snake is a reptile. Therefore ........

pilihan.B: A snake does not have fur
pilihan.C: A snake is not a reptile
pilihan.D: Snake is reptile, so it has fur

soal.penjelasan: Tidak ada reptil berbulu dan ular adalah reptil, jadi ular tidak berbulu.

soal.soal: Every time I eat peanuts, my throat swells up, therefore .....

pilihan.A: I must be allergic to peanut
pilihan.C: My throat does not swell up because of peanut
pilihan.D: Peanut is good for my throat

soal.penjelasan: Kesimpulan paling masuk akal dari pola sebab-akibat tersebut adalah alergi kacang.

soal.soal: Which word does not belong to the others?
soal.penjelasan: Assignment, task, dan homework bermakna tugas; operation berarti operasi.

soal.soal: Which word does not belong to the others?
soal.penjelasan: Quiz, challenge, dan puzzle berbentuk permainan/tantangan; test adalah ujian formal. Soal ini dapat ditafsirkan lain.

soal.soal: Which word does not belong to the others?
soal.penjelasan: Error, mistake, dan fault bermakna kesalahan; probably (mungkin) adalah kata keterangan.

soal.soal: Which word does not belong to the others?
soal.penjelasan: Usual, common, dan ordinary bermakna biasa; seldom berarti jarang.

soal.soal: Which word does not belong to the others?
soal.penjelasan: Triumph, victory, dan win bermakna kemenangan; defeat berarti kekalahan.

soal.soal:
She felt elated after hearing the good news.
The underlined word "elated" means ...
soal.penjelasan: Elated (sangat gembira) bermakna joyful.

soal.soal:
The ancient ruins attracted many tourists.
The underlined word "ancient" means ...
soal.penjelasan: Ancient (kuno) bermakna old.

soal.soal:
They tried to resolve the issue quickly.
The underlined word "resolve" means ...
soal.penjelasan: Resolve (menyelesaikan) bermakna solve.

soal.soal:
The new policy will enhance the company's reputation.
The underlined word "enhance" means ...
soal.penjelasan: Enhance (meningkatkan) bermakna improve.

soal.soal:
She is known for her generosity toward in need.
The underlined word "generosity" means ...
soal.penjelasan: Generosity (kedermawanan) bermakna kindness.

soal.soal:
Read the following text to answer the questions!

One afternoon, a Lion had just finished his meal and decided to take his afternoon nap. The Lion had just closed his eyes, when a Gnat saw him.
Now, this Gnat, though active and young, was also haughty and overconfident. He was extremely daring, and he attacked the Lion. The Lion was very angry and woke up with a start, but the Gnat did not stop. He kept stinging the Lion's nose, eyes and ears. The Lion roared in pain. He tried to crush the Gnat but all his attempts went in vain. The Gnat had no pity on the poor beast.
At last, the poor Lion was exhausted and bleeding on the ground. The Gnat, extremely pleased on his victory over the King of the Forest, hovered over the spot, praising himself and feeling joyful. His pleasure blinded him so much, that while flying, he suddenly got stuck in a Spider-web. No matter how much he tried, the Gnat could not escape.
Thus, the Gnat who had defeated the mighty Lion became the prey of the Spider.

What is the story above about?
soal.penjelasan: Tokoh utama cerita adalah nyamuk kecil (gnat): kesombongannya, kemenangannya, hingga ia terperangkap sarang laba-laba. Soal ini dapat ditafsirkan lain (D).

From the text we can conclude that ....

pilihan.A: The Gnat felt pity to the lion

soal.soal:
Read the following text to answer the questions!

Once two friends were walking through the forest. They knew that anything dangerous can happen to them at any time in the forest. So, they promised each other that they would remain united in any case of danger.
Suddenly, they saw a large bear approaching them. One of the friends at once climbed a nearby tree. But the other one did not know how to climb. So being led by his common sense, he lay down on the ground breathless, pretending to be a dead man.
The bear came near the man lying on the ground. It smelt in his ears and slowly left the place. Because the bears did not touch the dead creatures, the friend on the tree came down and asked his friend on the ground, "Friend, what did the bear tell you into your ears?" The other friend replied, "The bear advised me not to believe a false friend."

The word "pretending" in paragraph 2 means ....
soal.penjelasan: Pretending (berpura-pura) bermakna make as if.

soal.soal:
Read the following text to answer the questions!

Hello Pat,

Thanks for your last letter. I hope you are fine. I'm writing to you from London where I'm spending my summer holidays with my sister Anna. I'm absolutely fascinated by the city, it's awesome! As you know, London is the capital city of England and it's on the River Thames. Anna and I are staying in a nice youth hostel, very close to the city center.
On the first day of out stay here, we spent a fortune on the flight on the famous London Eye. In only 30 minutes we saw more than fifty London's most famous landmarks The London Eye, which is the symbol of the city is the biggest observation wheel worldwide. After the flight, Anna and I went to watch Changing the Guard, which takes place inside the railings of Buckingham Palace. The Queen's Guard is always accompanied by a band and the ceremony lasts 45 minutes. It was amazing! Next, we took some photos of the Houses of Parliament, of Big Ben and of Westminster Abbey. And we had a nice walk along the riverside in the evening. I was mesmerized by London by night. That's all from me now.

Loads of love
Elin.

From the text we can conclude that ....

pilihan.A: The writer's summer holiday with her brother
pilihan.B: The writer's experience in Buckingham Palace
pilihan.C: The writer was fascinated on the River Thames
pilihan.D: The writer's summer holiday in London was really fascinating.

soal.penjelasan: Penulis berlibur di London bersama kakak/adik perempuannya dan terpukau oleh kota itu.

soal.soal:
I was mesmerized by London by night.
The underlined word "mesmerized" means ..........
soal.penjelasan: Mesmerized (terpukau) bermakna amazed.

Thank you for your letter. I'm very happy to hear that you're planning to come to Japan. There are some nice places to...... (42) around my hometown. There's a beautiful lake called "Towada-Ko". This is Japan's deepest and... (43) lake, and there are beautiful forests all around it. Perhaps.......(44) can go camping together. It's sometimes cool in the evenings here... (45) we're in the northern part of Japan, so don't forget to bring a jacket, warm clothes, and some good shoes.

I'm very much looking forward to seeing you. Enjoy your flight.

From your good friend,
